{{Quote|We have Chief of State Daala to thank for it. Her leadership of the GA has resulted in a resurgence of interest in late Republicana and early Imperial artifacts. As a speculator, one can't go wrong. But the serious collector suffers for it.|Lestra Oxic, to Koi Quire|<ref name="Millennium Falcon (novel)">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>}}
'''Republicana''' was a term for art and antiques from the period of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] rule. [[Natasi Daala]]'s election as [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] led to an upswing in interest in Republicana by collectors and speculators, though devoted collectors such as [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Lestra Oxic]] had been pursuing such items well before.
